definitions.explanation: An object made by skilled manual work, often combining artistic beauty with practical function. Includes pottery, lacquerware, textiles, metalwork, and other traditional or modern crafts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧{工芸品|こうげいひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a traditional craft product.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{漆器|しっき}→漆器：13329_shikki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{工芸品|こうげいひん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: This area is famous for its lacquerware crafts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧ひとつ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{工芸品|こうげいひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧{生産品|せいさんひん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{温|あたた}かみ→温かみ：25336_atatakami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Handicrafts made one by one by artisans have a warmth that mass-produced goods lack.

notes:
USAGE: Japan has a national designation system for ⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧{工芸品|こうげいひん} (Traditional Craft Products), which currently recognizes over 200 types across the country. Common examples include ⟦{有田焼|ありたやき}→有田焼：28604_aritayaki⟧ (Arita porcelain), {輪島塗|わじまぬり} (Wajima lacquerware), and {西陣織|にしじんおり} (Nishijin textiles).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧{工芸品|こうげいひん}: traditional craft product
- {工芸品|こうげいひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make crafts
- {工芸品|こうげいひん}⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧: craft shop
- ⟦{民芸品|みんげいひん}→民芸品：21116_mingeihin⟧: folk craft
